ink.note: Light mode reads dark-to-light (ink at the dark end, paper at the light end); dark mode reverses which end is background vs. text, per The Paper Rule in DESIGN.md.

display.purpose: Screen titles and the wordmark only. Rare — most typographic voice comes from Legend and Numeral.

numeral.purpose: Every measured value: weights, deltas, dates, velocity, percentages.

legend.purpose: Section chrome substitute — card captions, nav labels, status pills, settings descriptions.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The Log Weight bottom sheet and the sign-in CTA only — the system's sole two exceptions to The Flat Instrument Rule.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every tappable primary/icon control compresses slightly on press.

motion.name: sheet-spring
motion.purpose: The Log Weight sheet slides up with physical spring motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width primary call to action (e.g. Save Entry).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-track, #c1502b); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; padding: 16px 24px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-track-deep, #9c3d20); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-track, #c1502b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Legend Tile
components.description: Dashboard stat card: legend-style label, tabular numeral value, hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-legend-tile { background: var(--color-surface, #fbf9f1); padding: 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #ddd3b8); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-legend-tile__label { color: var(--color-ink-faint, #8992a6); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-legend-tile__value-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; } .ds-legend-tile__value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--color-ink, #14213d); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-legend-tile__unit { color: var(--color-ink-faint, #8992a6); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-legend-tile__sub { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #56617a); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; margin-top: 12px; }

components.name: Forecast Sparkline
components.description: Signature component: a small inline trend line with a widening cone-of-uncertainty wedge at the leading edge.
components.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 280 56" class="ds-sparkline"><path d="M270 24 L276 14 L276 34 Z" class="ds-sparkline__cone"/><path d="M4 40 L270 24" class="ds-sparkline__line"/><circle cx="270" cy="24" r="3" class="ds-sparkline__dot"/></svg>

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Toggleable context tag, selected and unselected states.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: none; background: var(--color-surface-hover, #efe9d8); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #56617a); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-surface-active, #e7dfc9); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-chip--selected { background: var(--color-track, #c1502b); color: #fff; }

components.name: Instrument Rail (Nav)
components.description: Bottom navigation: icon + legend-label per tab, squared record-a-reading button.
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background: var(--color-surface,#fbf9f1); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line,#ddd3b8); padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-rail__link { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:none; border:none; color: var(--color-ink-faint,#8992a6); font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; font-size:8px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.09em; } .ds-rail__link--active { color: var(--color-track,#c1502b); } .ds-rail__fab { width:56px; height:48px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-track,#c1502b); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:2px solid var(--color-paper,#f5f1e4); margin-top:-24px; box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }

narrative.overview: Pivot reads like a weather bulletin for your body: the trend is a forecast track, today's raw reading is one noisy observation, and a widening cone of uncertainty is how the system admits it isn't certain. This replaces Pivot's earlier 'Quiet Clinician' identity (flat blue-on-slate, soft rounded shapes) after that system was judged dated and too close to generic clinical-SaaS chrome. The underlying product did not change; only the visual world did. The palette is warm chart-paper cream and deep navy ink, not cold slate-and-blue. One accent — a confident coral-red 'forecast track' — carries every primary action and every number that matters. Typography pairs a condensed legend-style display face with tabular monospace numerals. Shape language moved from rounded-everything/no-borders to small radii and real hairline borders doing a chart's separation work; there is no soft drop-shadow anywhere in the system. Dark mode is its own scene — a chart room at night — not a mechanical inversion. Built with headroom for a confirmed future direction: Pivot is meant to grow into an AI macro tracker and body scanner, and the instrument/forecast metaphor was chosen because it extends cleanly to other kinds of body data.
keyCharacteristics: One accent — warm coral-red 'track' — carries every primary action and every number that matters
Warm cream chart-paper ground and deep navy ink, never cold slate-and-blue
Condensed, tracked, uppercase 'legend' micro-type (8-10px) standing in for section chrome
Tabular monospace numerals for every measured value
Hairline borders and small radii (4-6px) doing the separation work; no soft drop-shadows anywhere
A literal cone-of-uncertainty sparkline on the Dashboard, and a shaded projection band on the Forecast chart
Dark mode is its own considered scene ('the chart room at night'), not an inverted palette

rules.name: The One Track Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent hue. A second saturated color is never introduced for emphasis; new emphasis is a weight/shade change on Track, or a move to a semantic state color.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The system's neutrals are warm (cream/tan-gray), never cool slate. A new neutral token must pick a warm-family value consistent with the paper or night-chart-room scene.

rules.name: The Reused Muted Rule
rules.body: ink-muted and ink-faint are allowed to share a value rather than manufacturing a fourth gray step that cannot pass WCAG AA at the sizes this system uses text at.

rules.name: The Instrument Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any value the product actually measured or calculated is set in tabular monospace (JetBrains Mono); words and labels are not.

rules.name: The Legend-Not-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Section headers, captions, and status text use the small tracked uppercase Legend style instead of icons, dividers, or a heavier heading.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Depth is drawn with a line and a tone step, not a shadow. A new component reaching for box-shadow to separate itself is solving the problem the wrong way in this system.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent hue (Track); new emphasis is a weight/shade change or a semantic state color.
Do set every measured value in tabular monospace (JetBrains Mono).
Do use the Legend style for section chrome instead of icons, dividers, or a heavier heading.
Do separate surfaces with a hairline border and a background-tone step, not a shadow.
Do give dark mode its own considered values rather than mechanically inverting light-mode hex.
Do keep celebratory/streak moments inside the calm bulletin-strip vocabulary.
donts: Don't reach for box-shadow to separate a component from its background — the system has none outside the Log Weight sheet and the sign-in CTA.
Don't use a radius larger than 6px on an ordinary card or button.
Don't introduce Space Grotesk, Inter-as-display, or any other prior-system typographic choice.
Don't add gamification chrome (badges, leaderboards, confetti, streak-shaming).
Don't style a new destructive or status color without checking it reads as clearly distinct from Track's orange-leaning coral, especially in dark mode.
